summary: Piermont Valley Acquisition Corp (SPAC) filed an 8-K on April 17, 2026, announcing a definitive merger agreement with Tigerless Health, Inc. and its subsidiaries. The transaction involves a reverse merger where Tigerless and Piermont become wholly-owned subsidiaries of a new public entity (Pubco), with securityholders of both sides receiving Pubco stock. No per-share price, premium, or implied valuation was disclosed. The boards of both companies have approved the deal, which is expected to close in the second half of 2026, subject to stockholder approvals and other conditions. As a SPAC de-SPAC transaction, watch for shareholder redemption risk and regulatory clearance timelines.
